wages.text: Boafo championed legislation to raise Maryland's minimum wage to $20.
wages.quote: and a bill to raise the state’s minimum wage to $20.

debt.text: Boafo said Social Security and the benefits seniors have earned must be safeguarded.
debt.quote: It's critically important that we safeguard Social Security and defend the benefits seniors earned and rely on.

housing.text: Boafo co-introduced legislation requiring increased density for qualifying affordable-housing projects and limiting certain local zoning barriers.
housing.quote: Land Use – Affordable Housing – Zoning Density and Permitting (Housing Expansion and Affordability Act of 2024)

immigration.text: Boafo said immigration enforcement should focus on violent offenders rather than law-abiding families and that ICE must be abolished in its current form.
immigration.quote: Immigration enforcement resources should prioritize violent offenders, traffickers, cartel networks, and those who endanger public safety — not law-abiding families contributing to our economy. In its current form, ICE must be abolished.

guns.text: Boafo co-sponsored legislation prohibiting the manufacture, sale, purchase or transfer of pistols readily convertible into machine guns.
guns.quote: Prohibiting a person from manufacturing, selling, offering for sale, purchasing, receiving, or transferring a certain convertible pistol; and defining "convertible pistol" as any semiautomatic pistol that can be converted into a machine gun solely by the attachment of a switch/auto-sear.

abortion.text: Boafo co-sponsored a Maryland constitutional amendment protecting reproductive decisions, including the decision to end a pregnancy.
abortion.quote: REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE ABILITY TO MAKE AND EFFECTUATE DECISIONS TO PREVENT, CONTINUE, OR END ONE’S OWN PREGNANCY.

health.text: Boafo said he supports Medicare for All while retaining a private option.
health.quote: For healthcare, I'd support Medicare for All with a private option.

energy.text: Boafo sponsored legislation requiring new buildings and certain renovations to be all-electric by 2035 and ready for electric vehicles or solar power.
energy.quote: HB1279 requires construction of all new buildings and certain renovations be all-electric by 2035 to meet the state's zero-emission-ready standards.

voting.text: Boafo said he would support the Freedom to Vote Act and the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.
voting.quote: When elected, I will support The Freedom to Vote Act, The John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, and The DISCLOSE Act.

tax.text: Chaffee advocated recurring tax cuts to promote economic growth.
tax.quote: I say lower taxes ever year this will continue to promote a good and healthy economy

trade.text: Chaffee endorsed broad tariffs, particularly on imported steel and aluminum.
trade.quote: Tariffs across the board especially on steel and aluminum

housing.text: Chaffee attributed high housing costs to shortages and called for minimizing residential and commercial permitting.
housing.quote: Home and rent costs have skyrocketed due to shortage of home builders funding and land. We need to minimize the permit process for both residential and commercial construction.

schools.text: Chaffee strongly endorsed school choice, including vouchers and tax credits.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax

guns.quote: The Constitution states the right to bear Arms
